what: a symmetric through-all cut by a 45 deg wedge across the end of a slotted ring (r 22.5..40, a 3 mm slot, 75 mm long): truck left a stray planar sheet out to the sketch's boundary at x = -65, with no error
method: the ring section (YZ) is the annulus less the slot |y| < 1.5 above it: A = pi*(40^2-22.5^2) - Int_-1.5^1.5 (sqrt(1600-y^2)-sqrt(506.25-y^2)) dy. The XZ sketch has y = -Z, so the wedge is z >= -0.014, x <= -37.5 + z + 0.014, through all y: it removes Int over the section with z >= -0.014 of (z + 0.014) dA (python quadrature). V = 75*A - removed. Nothing may stand outside the ring: bbox x -37.5..37.5, y -40..40, z -40..39.97186 (the outer arc at the slot)
